questions.label: Product-specific restrictions
questions.ask: Besides the standard list (violence, abuse, hate, malware, fraud, spam, infringement), what else is off limits?
options: Reselling or sharing accounts
Scraping, load testing or probing the service's security
Uploading regulated data (health records, card numbers)
Using the product to build a competing product
questions.fills: AUP: Restricted purposes (added to the adapted source list)

questions.label: AI features
questions.ask: Does the product have AI features that need their own rules?
options: No AI features
Yes: no illegal or harmful output, no bypassing safety limits
Yes, and we follow our model provider's usage policy too
questions.codebase: LLM SDK imports (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK) and prompt handling code.

questions.label: Usage limits
questions.ask: How do you limit heavy or automated use?
options: Fair use: no load far beyond normal use of the plan
Published rate limits and quotas
No usage limits in this policy
questions.codebase: Rate limiting middleware, plan quotas, API throttling config.

questions.label: Abuse reports
questions.ask: Which email address should receive abuse reports?
questions.fills: AUP: How to report abuse (replaces both Basecamp addresses)
questions.codebase: security.txt, existing policy pages, support email config.

questions.label: First response
questions.ask: How soon will you confirm you are looking into a report?
options: Within one business day
Within two business days
Within five business days
questions.fills: AUP: How to report abuse (response promise)

questions.label: Enforcement
questions.ask: What happens when someone breaks the policy?
options: Warn first, then suspend; suspend at once for serious harm
Remove the content; suspend repeat offenders
Suspend or close the account at our discretion
questions.fills: AUP: enforcement paragraph (replaces the 'we will take action' link)

questions.label: Customer responsibility
questions.ask: Is the customer responsible for what its invited users do?
options: Yes, the customer answers for its users
No, each user answers for themselves

questions.label: Reporter privacy
questions.ask: Will you keep a reporter's identity from the reported account?
options: Yes, unless the law requires disclosure
No promise either way
questions.fills: AUP: How to report abuse (confidentiality sentence)
